hamiltonian: H = -t1 sum_{<i,j>,s} (c+_{is} c_{js} + h.c.) - t2 sum_{<<i,j>>,s} (c+_{is} c_{js} + h.c.) + U sum_i n_{i,up} n_{i,down} + V sum_{<i,j>} n_i n_j
notation: <i,j> = nearest-neighbor pairs; <<i,j>> = next-nearest-neighbor pairs; n_i = n_{i,up} + n_{i,down}; h.c. = Hermitian conjugate
spin_orbital_map: index = 2 * site + spin, where spin=0 is up and spin=1 is down
